fd7654db595dad5deed75e72434f56f2b563bcf3.en: # Verification of the Public Assistance Recipients Survey (started 2026-11-17) Verification status: Machine-verified only

4c6971bdbe93a5adfc658bfd4ba76855a2ff541d.ja:
## 対象と取得
- 厚生労働省 被保護者調査（月次概数）の報道発表資料 17本（令和7年4月分〜令和8年8月分）。取得記録：data/raw/seiho/MANIFEST.tsv。
4c6971bdbe93a5adfc658bfd4ba76855a2ff541d.en:
## Scope and retrieval
- Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare Public Assistance Recipients Survey (monthly preliminary figures): 17 press releases (April 2025 to August 2026). Retrieval log: data/raw/seiho/MANIFEST.tsv.

7d8957ae92cbddea989fe292b37d89c947a4f39a.ja:
## c3301
- 各本：対前年同月差・伸び率・対前月差、世帯類型の内訳の和と構成割合。版間：m月分の当月 = m+1月分の前月 = m+12月分の前年同月。式 1,136、不一致 0。
7d8957ae92cbddea989fe292b37d89c947a4f39a.en:
## c3301
- Each release: difference from the same month of the previous year, growth rate and difference from the previous month; sum of the breakdown by household type and the composition ratios. Between editions: current month in the release for month m = previous month in the release for month m+1 = same month of the previous year in the release for month m+12. Formulas: 1,136; mismatches: 0.

8fba4f436f141d6de660741ee799427fb7b236fd.ja:
## 陰性対照
- 令和8年8月分の被保護実人員の当月を pdftotext の出力で変えて検出（PDF の検査は、読み出した文字を置き換えて確かめる）。
8fba4f436f141d6de660741ee799427fb7b236fd.en:
## Negative control
- Detected after the current-month value of the actual number of recipients in the August 2026 release was altered in the pdftotext output (PDF checks are confirmed by replacing the extracted text).
